findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_headers, check_test, explain_architecture, find_code, project_memory, Zephex_dev_info · Private data: audit_headers, check_test, explain_architecture, find_code, get_project_context, keep_thinking, project_memory, read_code · Public sink: audit_headers, Zephex_dev_info · Destructive: check_test, get_project_context, keep_thinking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_headers, check_test, explain_architecture, find_code, project_memory, Zephex_dev_info · Private data: audit_headers, check_test, explain_architecture, find_code, get_project_context, keep_thinking, project_memory, read_code · Public sink: audit_headers, Zephex_dev_info · Destructive: check_test, get_project_context, keep_thinking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
